source: PHC Core Rules v1.0, Levels and XP: Essence of Experience (added after 1.1; the 2020 sheet's starting inventory)

items.name: Essence of Experience
items.text: Experience sealed in mana. Someone with Mastery 2 in Brain Power and an Evoker, or Will Power and an Emanator, can crack it in 10 minutes out of combat; they choose who absorbs it, themselves or a party member present. Worth 100 XP. A character can absorb one per long rest. Sells well.

effects.limit: one absorbed per character per long rest
